name: Weltzeit-Rechner
tagline: Translates global event times into yours and renders shareable world-clock graphics.
description: Answers the question every international audience asks: what time does that happen for me? Ask about a global event, a livestream or a rocket launch and the conversion to your own clock comes straight back. It also renders world-clock graphics ready to post, so the answer travels well to followers in other zones.
author: GeorgGrok
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
